name: InfoPay network
notes: InfoPay runs several people-search sites: BackgroundCheckers.net, CheckSecrets, MugshotLook, PeopleSearch123, PeopleSearcher, PrivateRecords and FreeBackgroundCheck.us. One email asks all of them. InfoTracer, also InfoPay's, has its own form plugin.
source: BADBOOL InfoPay entries and redact.dev's InfoTracer guide (updated 2026-08-11), which give this address.
